fishing_area_map(): FAO主要渔区及其分区地图

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/fishing_area_map.Rmd
fishing_area_map.Rmd

英文原页：fishing_area_map()

说明

该函数绘制一个FAO主要海洋渔区及其亚区（subarea）、区（division）或分区（subdivision），并标出其代码（例如27.4为北海），边界来自本包自带的渔区图层（inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp，FAO，CC BY 4.0）。安装了ggOceanMaps包（Vihtakari 2026，https://github.com/MikkoVihtakari/ggOceanMaps）时，地图画在它的海底地形底图上：延伸到纬度60度以外的渔区（例如27区）采用极地立体投影，其他渔区采用经纬度坐标；水深取自ggOceanMaps自带的低分辨率ETOPO 2022地形模型（无需下载）。未安装ggOceanMaps时，以渔区为中心的兰伯特方位等积投影绘制Natural Earth的陆地，不显示水深。

English

This function maps one FAO major marine fishing area with its subareas, divisions or subdivisions, labelled with their codes (e.g. 27.4, the North Sea), from the boundaries bundled with the package (inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp, FAO, CC BY 4.0). When the ggOceanMaps package (Vihtakari 2026, https://github.com/MikkoVihtakari/ggOceanMaps) is installed, the map is drawn on its bathymetric base map: polar stereographic for areas reaching beyond 60 degrees of latitude (e.g. area 27), else in longitude and latitude, with the depth from the low-resolution ETOPO 2022 relief model bundled with ggOceanMaps (no download needed). Without ggOceanMaps, the land of Natural Earth is drawn in a Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection centred on the area, without depth.

用法 

fishing_area_map(
  area,
  level = c("subarea", "division", "subdivision", "none"),
  bathymetry = TRUE,
  labels = TRUE,
  engine = c("auto", "ggOceanMaps", "sf"),
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = fao_setting("pptx"),
  plot_show = fao_setting("plot_show")
)

参数

area
FAO主要海洋渔区：代码（例如27）或英文名称（例如”Atlantic, Northeast”）。
English The FAO major marine fishing area: its code (e.g. 27) or English name (e.g. “Atlantic, Northeast”).
level
渔区内绘制的单元：“subarea”（亚区，默认）、“division”（区）、“subdivision”（分区）或”none”（只画渔区边界）。没有该级单元的渔区只画其边界。
English The units drawn inside the area: “subarea” (default), “division”, “subdivision” or “none” (the outline of the area only). Areas without units at the level asked for are drawn with their outline only.
bathymetry
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时显示水深（仅限ggOceanMaps）。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the depth is shown (ggOceanMaps only).
labels
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，在各单元上标出其代码。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the units are labelled with their codes.
engine
绘图方式：“auto”（默认，已安装ggOceanMaps时用它，否则用”sf”）、“ggOceanMaps”或”sf”。
English How the map is drawn: “auto” (default, ggOceanMaps when installed, else “sf”), “ggOceanMaps” or “sf”.
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，地图保存在figures/png/area/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the map is saved in figures/png/area/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，单元表保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the table of units is saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the map text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，地图还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/area/。默认为fao_settings()中的设置（未更改时为FALSE）。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the map is also saved as an editable PowerPoint file in figures/pptx/area/. Default is the value set with fao_settings() (FALSE unless changed).
plot_show
逻辑值。为TRUE时，每张图在保存的同时也画在绘图窗口中（例如RStudio的Plots窗格），便于立即查看。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(plot_show = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。无论是否显示，图表都会保存为文件（plot = TRUE）。
English A logical value. If TRUE, each chart is also drawn in the plot window (e.g. the Plots pane of RStudio) as it is saved, to look at it at once. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(plot_show = TRUE). The charts are saved as files (plot = TRUE) either way.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含map（ggplot对象）、units（每个单元一行：code、level、name_en）、engine（绘图方式）、fao_map（该渔区FAO官方地图的链接）和sources（所用的边界、底图和水深数据，引用地图时一并引用）。

English

Invisibly, a list with map (the ggplot object), units (one row per unit: code, level, name_en), engine, fao_map (link to the official FAO map of the area) and sources (the boundaries, base map and depth data used, to cite with the map).

详细说明

该渔区的FAO官方地图链接在返回结果的fao_map中；见fao_areas()。

English

The official FAO map of the area is linked in the result (fao_map); see fao_areas().

参考文献

FAO (2024). FAO Major Fishing Areas for Statistical Purposes. In: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Division [online]. Licence: CC-BY 4.0. https://www.fao.org/fishery/geonetwork?uuid=ac02a460-da52-11dc-9d70-0017f293bd28

NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (2022). ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. doi:10.25921/fd45-gt74

Vihtakari, M. (2026). ggOceanMaps: Plot Data on Oceanographic Maps using ‘ggplot2’. R package version 3.0.0. doi:10.32614/CRAN.package.ggOceanMaps, https://github.com/MikkoVihtakari/ggOceanMaps

另请参阅

fao_areas() for all areas.

示例 

# The Northeast Atlantic and its subareas (27.1 Barents Sea, ..., 27.14 East Greenland)
ne_atlantic <- fishing_area_map(27, lang = "zh")
ne_atlantic$units

# Its divisions, without depth
fishing_area_map("Atlantic, Northeast", level = "division", bathymetry = FALSE)
